rho=lambda/lambda_max controls a relative regularization path. Each training
or bootstrap sample recomputes lambda_max for each alpha. Grouped loadings are
measurement parameters; they do not become directed structural edges through
selected_edges().

This is a method note, not a second executed data example. The runnable
synthetic example is basic-cfa.Rmd and the packaged examples/quick_start.R.
